title: Transaction comment claims 'failure anywhere rolls both marks back', but invalid-sender clear errors are swallowed (logged) and the transaction still commits
detail: clear_rejected_stamps returns Nil, logs clear failures, and the pog.transaction commits anyway. A legacy invalid sender whose clear errors stays stamped-without-send, contradicting the comment (narrow: needs a legacy malformed row plus a clear-statement error).
recommended_fix: Either thread the clear through result.try so its error rolls back, or soften the comment to say clear failures are logged and committed.

title: Spam-path handler wiring unpinned: honeypot/timing call sites passing genuine_submission=False have no handler-level test
detail: Spec: spam fake-confirmation must NOT fire the confirmation event. Predicates (is_honeypot_filled/is_timing_suspicious) and view render with False are pinned, but flipping the False literal at a handler call site fires application_confirmation_viewed on bot renders and no test fails.
recommended_fix: Add a test posting a honeypot-filled/timing-suspicious form through the handler asserting data-apply-page="spam-confirmation" and absence of apply_analytics.js.

title: Reminder-button enable/disable predicate (remindable == 0 && followup == 0 || pending) untested — only label strings pinned
detail: Behaviour changed from remindable == 0 || pending; a revert greys out the button when only follow-ups are due, making stage 2 unsendable, and no test fails. awaiting_section_test.gleam covers only reminder_button_label/row_stage_label.
recommended_fix: Extract a pure reminder_button_disabled helper and pin it, or add a view-level test: enabled with remindable=0, followup>0.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%; P1 ~82-85% (reminder SQL gates/transaction FULL, email builders/subjects/UTM/tags-shape FULL, SSR markers + 8 section ids FULL, analytics pure logic FULL; gaps: spam handler wiring, disabled predicate, send-site tag pairing, initBrowser DOM glue, closes_at tz). Overall ~85%.
recommended_fix: Land the four gap findings to raise P1 to >=90% and the gate to PASS.

title: Stage-1 awaiting-membership rule still triplicated despite the view's 'single home' contract
detail: Stage-2 gate is centralised (interval '2 days' only in the view), but the who-is-awaiting predicate (unreminded, non-empty sender, not an applicant) still lives in mark_reminders_for_vacancy.sql and list_awaiting_for_vacancy.sql's latest CTE. A future membership change silently desyncs stage-1 mark from count/list.
recommended_fix: Point stage-1 mark/list at the view (has_unreminded / membership join) the same way the stage-2 consumers read stage2_due.

title: month_name helper copied a third time with a third return shape (Option/Result/String)
detail: Repo convention is DRY at 2+ repeats; the diff's own comment acknowledges the third copy and defers consolidation, but no deferred-work.md entry tracks it.
recommended_fix: Consolidate into one shared helper with thin adapters, or add an explicit deferred-work.md entry.

title: Mixed-pool button label and toast drop the singular handling the single-stage branches keep
detail: Pool (1,1) renders 'Send 1 reminders + 1 follow-ups' and 'Reminders on their way to 1 people, follow-ups to 1 more', while single-stage branches special-case the singular.
recommended_fix: Add singular variants to the mixed branches.

title: Makefile help for 'make test' still says '(shared, client, server — no Docker needed)' though the target now runs test-js
detail: The test target gained test-js and a separate test-js help line was added, but the make test description wasn't updated.
recommended_fix: Update the help line to mention js (and the node requirement).

title: mark_followup_reminders_for_vacancy RETURNING includes sender_name, which nothing consumes
detail: Generated MarkFollowupRemindersForVacancyRow decodes sender_name, but the handler maps stage2_rows only to sender_email; the field is dead weight in RETURNING + decoder.
recommended_fix: Drop sender_name from RETURNING and regenerate (or name a planned consumer).

title: clear_rejected_stamps logs 'reminder stamp cleared' regardless of stage, though called for both stage-1 and stage-2 clears
detail: handle_send_outcome labels log lines per stage; the sibling self-heal path does not, so a stage-2 invalid-sender clear is indistinguishable from stage-1 in logs.
recommended_fix: Pass a stage label into clear_rejected_stamps and include it in the warning line.

title: Resend tag slug pairing at the four applicant send call sites unpinned (payload shape pinned, call sites never exercised)
detail: build_send_body's tags JSON shape is pinned (email_client_test.gleam:605), but a swapped/wrong template slug at a call site ships silently despite the spec requiring per-template tags on every applicant email.
recommended_fix: Extract a pure per-template tags builder and pin the slug for each of the four templates.

title: apply_analytics.js initBrowser DOM glue (marker reads, error-prop parsing, listener registration) never executed in tests — ticketed deferral
detail: Node tests require the module without a document, so initBrowser never runs; deferred-work.md:539 tickets the happy-dom/jsdom test. A parsing/wiring regression fails no test.
recommended_fix: Land the ticketed happy-dom/jsdom initBrowser test.

title: Dublin-local closes_at conversion in find_vacancy_for_invite untested — feeds the stage-2 deadline email's announced date
detail: to_char(closes_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin', 'YYYY-MM-DD') has no assertion; a regression makes the deadline email name the wrong close date.
recommended_fix: Integration test seeding a late-evening-UTC closes_at, asserting the Dublin-local date string.
